privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: Daydream is a portfolio demo. This page explains what personal data the demo keeps, why, for how long and who is responsible for it.

items.i1: Accounts: name, e-mail address, password hash, verification date and, if you sign in with GitHub or Google, that provider's account ID.
items.i2: Addresses and orders: full name, street, city, postal code, phone number and order history.
items.i3: Voices (product reviews): the text and rating, public on the product page together with the author's name.
items.i4: Unverified registrations: an e-mail address typed into the registration form, possibly by someone who does not own it.
items.i5: Rate-limit and mail counters in Redis: keys that contain IP addresses and e-mail addresses.
items.i6: Backups of the database and uploads, including the dump taken before a demo reset.
items.i7: Server logs; a failed e-mail is logged with the recipient's address.

purposes.heading: Why and on what legal basis

items.i1: Running the account and the test orders you ask for: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.
items.i2: Protecting the demo from abuse with limits, CAPTCHA and logs: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

items.i1: Accounts, addresses, orders and Voices: until you delete the account or the owner runs a demo reset, whichever comes first. The demo may delete data at any time.
items.i5: Logs: as set by the server administrator.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: You can delete your account yourself in the account settings. For access, correction and the other rights under GDPR, write to {email}. You may also complain to the supervisory authority.

items.i1: Stripe: whatever you type into the hosted checkout.
items.i2: Cloudflare Turnstile: your IP address and browser signals on the registration and password reset forms.
items.i3: {provider}: the SMTP provider that delivers our e-mails, which sees the recipient's address and the message.

admin.heading: The public demo admin
admin.body: The public demo admin account cannot see any of this data.

cookies.heading: Cookies and storage
cookies.body: There is no cookie banner because the demo uses only strictly necessary storage: the session cookie, the cart in your browser's localStorage, and Cloudflare Turnstile for security.

footer.demo: A portfolio demo. Nothing here is for sale.

hero.title: Granola and muesli for slow mornings
hero.lead: Daydream mixes small batches of granola and muesli from oats, nuts, seeds and fruit. Pick a bag and start the day your way.

about.title: Why Daydream
about.lead: Daydream started with a simple idea: breakfast should be easy to make and good to eat. We build our mixes from whole grains, nuts, seeds and dried fruit, and keep the ingredient lists short.

balance.title: Balanced recipes
balance.desc: Each mix balances grains, protein and fruit, so it is not too sweet.

simple.title: Short ingredient lists
simple.desc: Every product page lists what is in the bag.

categories.title: Shop by category

process.title: How we make it

select.title: Choose the ingredients
